evidence_boundary: Automated local and fake-adapter evidence; authenticated live services, sustained-duration execution, native platforms, independent review, and release publication require separate evidence.

scenarios.claim: Five independent tasks receive distinct concurrent pod identities.
scenarios.limitations: Deterministic local workers; real-provider concurrency is separately opt-in.

scenarios.claim: Unused capacity stays idle when fewer tasks are ready.
scenarios.limitations: Scheduler-level deterministic evidence.

scenarios.claim: Dependency-blocked tasks are excluded from admission.
scenarios.limitations: Uses the canonical local task graph.

scenarios.claim: Equal, ancestor, descendant, and declared path conflicts are rejected.
scenarios.limitations: Generated and rename paths must be declared in the task authority.

scenarios.claim: Exclusive test resources and actor limits serialize conflicting work.
scenarios.limitations: External resources are protected only when declared.

scenarios.claim: A panicking implementation worker does not cancel healthy siblings.
scenarios.limitations: Local worker-failure injection.

scenarios.claim: A timed-out pod is cancelled without terminating healthy siblings.
scenarios.limitations: Local deterministic timeout injection.

scenarios.claim: Campaign cancellation reconciles all owned pods and preserves unrelated processes.
scenarios.limitations: Linux process evidence; native-platform evidence is separate.

scenarios.claim: Unauthorized or nonexistent lead assignments fail before leasing.
scenarios.limitations: Structured lead-output corpus.

scenarios.claim: Overlapping assignments in one lead response are refused.
scenarios.limitations: Deterministic proposal validation.

scenarios.claim: A candidate with an undeclared changed path is refused before staging.
scenarios.limitations: Coordinator-owned Git commit boundary.

scenarios.claim: Deterministic gate failure cannot advance to accepted integration.
scenarios.limitations: Fake workflow port with exact gate dispositions.

scenarios.claim: Changes-required findings return only to the matching correction lineage.
scenarios.limitations: Lineage and evidence binding are local and deterministic.

scenarios.claim: Bounded correction cycles rerun gates and cumulative review.
scenarios.limitations: Correction-port evidence; real providers require opt-in qualification.

scenarios.claim: Correction exhaustion stops without false completion.
scenarios.limitations: Deterministic correction fixture.

scenarios.claim: Blocked review outcomes remain terminal noncompletions.
scenarios.limitations: Structured fake reviewer result.

scenarios.claim: Malformed reviewer output fails closed without downstream effect.
scenarios.limitations: Adapter-level malformed-output corpus.

scenarios.claim: Only classified temporary provider failures retry within a bound.
scenarios.limitations: Deterministic failure classification and jitter.

scenarios.claim: Provider circuit breakers open and suppress retry storms.
scenarios.limitations: Production batch wrapper with deterministic provider failure.

scenarios.claim: Uncertain branch publication is observed before retry.
scenarios.limitations: Fake transport; authenticated GitHub evidence remains open.

scenarios.claim: Uncertain issue creation reconciles by idempotency key.
scenarios.limitations: Fake publication port; authenticated GitHub evidence remains open.

scenarios.claim: Uncertain pull-request creation reconciles by idempotency key.
scenarios.limitations: Fake publication port; authenticated GitHub evidence remains open.

scenarios.claim: Restart around external-write intent produces at most one remote effect.
scenarios.limitations: Fake transport at every represented publication boundary.

scenarios.claim: Exact-commit CI failure returns only the matching task to correction.
scenarios.limitations: Fake CI projection; live CI evidence remains open.

scenarios.claim: Simultaneously eligible tasks enter one serialized integration queue.
scenarios.limitations: Task candidates are represented locally; remote PRs use the same mapping.

scenarios.claim: Every completion permutation yields one stable integration order.
scenarios.limitations: Deterministic in-memory permutations plus durable round-trip coverage.

scenarios.claim: A stale campaign head is refused before integration mutation.
scenarios.limitations: Local Git integration fixture.

scenarios.claim: A changed reviewed commit identity is refused.
scenarios.limitations: Local Git identity fixture.

scenarios.claim: Transfer conflict preserves campaign head and candidate work.
scenarios.limitations: Local Git conflict fixture.

scenarios.claim: Declared cross-file semantic coupling requires shared-resource or cumulative validation.
scenarios.limitations: Arbitrary semantic inference remains a reviewer or human judgment boundary; declared contracts are deterministic.

scenarios.claim: A stale accepted delta transfers only through the coordinator-owned integration worktree.
scenarios.limitations: Local Git transfer fixture.

scenarios.claim: Changed effective integration diffs receive cumulative gates and review.
scenarios.limitations: Uses configured integration validation interval.

scenarios.claim: Failed integration verification preserves accepted candidates and releases temporary state.
scenarios.limitations: Local deterministic integration gate.

scenarios.claim: Integration interruption reconciles exactly once at each durable boundary.
scenarios.limitations: Local durable Git-boundary injection.

scenarios.claim: Restart does not duplicate owned task or publication identities.
scenarios.limitations: Fake remote identities; local branch, worktree, and session identities are durable.

scenarios.claim: Human-authored issue and pull-request bytes survive owned-section updates.
scenarios.limitations: Fake transport and renderer evidence.

scenarios.claim: Task-integration and destination-promotion policies reject stale or missing grants.

scenarios.claim: Explicit automatic destination promotion requires every immutable prerequisite.
